name: 63104 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63104 (Saint Louis) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63104 (Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
